The previous version failed because it compared `CobDecimal` values with `>`, `<` and `==`, and that type does not support comparisons. This version compares the plain `Decimal` from each field's `.value` instead.

```python
from decimal import Decimal

from cobol_equiv.runtime import (
    Storage, Group, Num, Alnum, Filler, move, compute, dec, initialize,
    display_line, Stdin,
)


def main(stdin: bytes, input_files: dict[str, bytes]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, bytes]]:
    ws = Storage("WS", [
        Num("WS-NUMBER", "9(4)", value=0),
        Num("WS-SAVE-NUMBER", "9(4)"),
        Group("WS-TBL-DEF", [
            Filler("X(7)", "1000M  "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0900CM "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0500D  "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0400CD "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0100C  "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0090XC "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0050L  "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0040XL "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0010X  "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0009IX "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0005V  "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0004IV "),
            Filler("X(7)", "0001I  "),
        ]),
        Group("WS-TBL-R", [
            Group("WS-TBL-ENT", [
                Num("WS-TBL-DIVISOR", "9(4)"),
                Alnum("WS-TBL-ROMAN-CH", "X(1)", occurs=3),
            ], occurs=13),
        ], redefines="WS-TBL-DEF"),
        Num("OCX", "99"),
        Group("WS-ROMAN", [
            Alnum("WS-ROMAN-CH", "X(1)", occurs=16),
        ]),
    ])

    out = bytearray()
    inp = Stdin(stdin)
    num = ws["WS-NUMBER"]
    save = ws["WS-SAVE-NUMBER"]
    ocx = ws["OCX"]
    roman = ws["WS-ROMAN"]

    inp.accept(num)
    while not (num.value == 0):
        move(num, save)
        if num.value > 0 and num.value < 4000:
            initialize(roman)
            move(0, ocx)
            rx = 1
            while not (num.value == 0):
                div = ws.f("WS-TBL-DIVISOR", rx)
                while not (num.value < div.value):
                    cx = 1
                    while ws.f("WS-TBL-ROMAN-CH", rx, cx).raw != b" ":
                        compute(ocx, dec(ocx) + dec(1))
                        move(ws.f("WS-TBL-ROMAN-CH", rx, cx),
                             ws.f("WS-ROMAN-CH", int(ocx)))
                        cx += 1
                    compute(num, dec(num) - dec(div))
                rx += 1
            out += display_line("inp=", save, " roman=", roman)
        else:
            out += display_line("inp=", save, " invalid")
        inp.accept(num)

    return bytes(out), {}
```
